name: Steps — numbered process
description: A 'how it works' process as an ordered list: a number badge, title, description and an optional image per step. Semantic <ol> (numbers come from the index; badges are aria-hidden). Cards cascade in left-to-right. 1/2/4 columns at mobile/md/lg.
